claims.text: Max single lidocaine dose (healthy adults): 4.5 mg/kg (2 mg/lb), never more than 300 mg total.
claims.quote: The maximum recommended single dose of lidocaine for healthy adults should be such that the dose of lidocaine does not exceed 4.5 mg/kg or 2 mg/lb body weight and does not in any case exceed a total of 300 mg.
